create_matcher_instance: create a Matcher instance with thresholds and labels to stratify prediction quality levels
call_matcher_with_quality_matrix: call the Matcher to assign ground-truth indices and labels to predictions from an MxN match quality matrix
set_low_quality_matches: set low quality matches for predictions that have maximum overlap with any ground-truth element
match_predictions_to_ground_truth: match predicted bounding boxes to ground-truth boxes using IoU-based quality thresholds
label_predictions_by_iou_thresholds: label each prediction as positive, negative, or ignored based on IoU threshold ranges
